gloss: going to bed early, early bedtime

definitions.gloss: going to bed early, early bedtime
definitions.explanation: The practice of going to sleep early in the evening. Often paired with {早起|はやお}き (early rising) as a healthy habit.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{早寝|はやね}しよう。
examples.english: Let's go to bed early today.

examples.japanese: {早寝|はやね}{早起|はやお}きは{健康|けんこう}にいい。
examples.english: Going to bed early and rising early is good for your health.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもの{頃|ころ}は{早寝|はやね}の{習慣|しゅうかん}があったが、{大人|おとな}になってからは{夜更|よふ}かしが{増|ふ}えた。
examples.english: I had a habit of going to bed early as a child, but since becoming an adult, I've been staying up late more often.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always appears in the set phrase {早寝|はやね}{早起|はやお}き (early to bed, early to rise). Can be used with する: {早寝|はやね}する (to go to bed early). The proverb {早寝|はやね}{早起|はやお}き{病|やまい}{知|し}らず means "early to bed and early to rise keeps you healthy."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {早寝|はやね}{早起|はやお}き: early to bed, early to rise
- {早寝|はやね}する: to go to bed early
- {早寝|はやね}の{習慣|しゅうかん}: habit of going to bed early

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {夜更|よふ}かし: staying up late (opposite habit)
